entities.summary: Feodosy Fedorovich Shchedrin (b. 1751, Saint Petersburg) was a musician or composer of the Early Modern period, marked by exploration, reformation, and the rise of nation-states, active in Saint Petersburg. Known in the fields of painters & sculptors.
